name: get_indicator_summary
description: Get a summary of technical indicator values for a specific timeframe. Returns the last 3 candles of key indicators: RSSI, ATR reversion %, structure power, Sharpe ratio, EMA200, leverage, climax signals.

timeframe.description: The timeframe to get indicators for (e.g., '1m', '5m', '15m', '1h', '4h', '1d', '1w', '1M')

name: get_price_action
description: Get OHLCV price action data for a specific timeframe. Returns the last N candles with open, high, low, close, volume.

num_candles.description: Number of recent candles to return (max 20)

name: capture_chart
description: Capture a screenshot of the multi-timeframe chart. Returns a chart image that you can analyze visually. Call this when you need to see the chart patterns, support/resistance levels, or visual confirmation of indicators.

timeframe.description: Which timeframe to focus the chart on (e.g., '4h'). The chart will show this timeframe by default.

name: get_multi_tf_overview
description: Get a quick overview across ALL configured timeframes. Returns the latest RSSI, ATR reversion %, climax signal, and trend direction for each timeframe. Useful for getting a bird's eye view of the market.

name: read_kb
description: Read a knowledge base topic. The KB stores persistent insights across scan cycles. Valid topics: market-regimes, indicator-quirks, ticker-personalities, false-signal-patterns, successful-setups, weight-tuning-log, risk-conditions, cross-ticker-signals, timeframe-biases, lessons-learned.

topic.description: The KB topic slug to read (e.g., 'market-regimes', 'lessons-learned')

name: write_kb
description: Write or append content to a knowledge base topic. Use markdown format. Content is appended to existing content. Max 2000 chars per write. Valid topics: market-regimes, indicator-quirks, ticker-personalities, false-signal-patterns, successful-setups, weight-tuning-log, risk-conditions, cross-ticker-signals, timeframe-biases, lessons-learned.

topic.description: The KB topic slug to write to (e.g., 'lessons-learned')

content.description: The markdown content to append to the topic file (max 2000 chars)
